GANTT chart of the work undertaken on the Rotorua Lake Modelling – PC10 project, from the initial data request (Nov 2025) to the current calibration and alum work (Nov 2026). Start and end dates for lake-model tasks are approximate and taken from the meeting notes and the dates pages were first added to the repository. Milestones (diamonds) are listed with links to the relevant pages in the [table below](#milestones).

```{mermaid}

gantt

    todayMarker on

    section Lake Model – Build
    Interim base model (LERNZmp)           :l1, 2025-11-17, 2026-02-15
```
